cases.sentence: Тот, кто входит в овечий загон не через ворота, а проникает другим путем, тот ___ и разбойник.
cases.translation: Whoever does not enter the sheepfold through the gate, but climbs in another way, is a thief and a robber.
cases.explain: Вор is a predicate noun describing the subject тот, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: У меня есть и другие овцы, не из этого ___.
cases.translation: I have other sheep that are not of this fold.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The sheep do not belong to the hired shepherd.
cases.explain: The verb принадлежать (to belong to) governs the dative case.
The transitive verb использовать takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.translation: So it was determined for me by my Father.
cases.explain: The agent of a passive construction is expressed in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: In Jerusalem the Feast of Dedication took place.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Тот, кто входит в овечий загон не через ворота, а проникает другим путем, тот вор и разбойник.
reading.question: How does Jesus describe someone who climbs into the sheepfold instead of entering through the gate?
reading.explain: The text calls one who climbs in another way instead of through the gate a thief and a robber.

reading.ru: Он зовет своих овец по именам и выводит их.
reading.question: How does the shepherd call his own sheep?
reading.explain: The shepherd calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, я дверь для овец.
reading.question: What does Jesus call himself in relation to the sheep?
reading.explain: Jesus says, 'I am the door for the sheep.'

reading.ru: Наемному пастуху овцы не принадлежат, и когда он видит, что пришел волк, он бросает овец и убегает.
reading.question: What does the hired hand do when he sees the wolf coming?
options: He abandons the sheep and runs away
He calls the shepherd for help
He hides the sheep in a cave
reading.correct: He abandons the sheep and runs away
reading.explain: The hired hand abandons the sheep and flees when he sees the wolf coming.

reading.ru: У меня есть и другие овцы, не из этого загона
reading.question: What does Jesus say about sheep that are not of this fold?
options: They belong to someone else forever
reading.explain: Jesus says he has other sheep not of this fold that he must also bring.

reading.ru: Никто ее у меня не может отнять, я отдаю ее добровольно.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about his own life?
options: No one can take it from him; he lays it down voluntarily
Someone forces him to give it up
reading.correct: No one can take it from him; he lays it down voluntarily
reading.explain: Jesus says no one can take his life from him; he lays it down voluntarily.

reading.ru: «Сколько ты еще будешь держать нас в недоумении?» — говорили они. «Если ты Христос, то так и скажи нам!»
reading.question: What did the Jews ask Jesus at the Feast of Dedication?
options: To plainly tell them if he was the Christ
reading.correct: To plainly tell them if he was the Christ
reading.explain: The Jews asked Jesus how long he would keep them in suspense and to tell them plainly if he was the Christ.

reading.ru: Я даю им жизнь вечную, и они никогда не погибнут.
reading.question: What does Jesus give his sheep?
options: Eternal life, so they will never perish
reading.correct: Eternal life, so they will never perish
reading.explain: Jesus says he gives his sheep eternal life and they will never perish.

reading.ru: Тогда иудеи опять схватили камни, чтобы побить его
reading.question: How did the Jews react after Jesus said, 'I and the Father are one'?
options: They picked up stones to stone him
reading.correct: They picked up stones to stone him
reading.explain: After Jesus said 'I and the Father are one,' the Jews picked up stones to stone him.

reading.ru: Затем Иисус отправился на другую сторону Иордана, туда, где Иоанн раньше крестил, и там оставался.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go after escaping from the Jews?
options: Across the Jordan, where John used to baptize
reading.correct: Across the Jordan, where John used to baptize
reading.explain: After escaping, Jesus went across the Jordan to where John used to baptize.
